name: Amelia Estelle
source:
A Mage-Caster and child prodigy, Amelia’s knowledge of magic exceeds what should be possible for someone of her age. She is very analytical and content to remain a quiet observer, but when she does speak it is with precision and refinement. 

[From official website]
